concerns: Light source is an unfiltered 300 W Xenon lamp (UV included); only Table 1 entry 11 used a 400-800 nm filter. This record is not demonstrably visible-light-only.
Yields are amounts (mg), not %; 90% of pellets converted. Percentages 74/15/11 are product distribution within the 360 mg.
Catalyst loading given as mass (200 mg) / substrate:catalyst ratio 5:2; irradiance not reported (lamp power only).
Circulatory/semi-batch: 8 h per cycle, 18-20 cycles; total time not a single value (time not among requested fields).
Main text says 18 cycles of steady production; Fig. 3 caption says 20 reaction cycles.

paper_concerns: Eligibility doubt: all reactions use a 300 W Xenon lamp at 80-150 °C; only Table 1 entry 11 (400-800 nm filter, 91 ± 6% conversion, 61 ± 5% selectivity) is shown to be visible-light. Temperatures of 150 °C under 10 bar O2 make the process photothermal.

Table 1 entries (conversion/selectivity with SD, n=3, 24 h) are numeric records not covered by the single task, including controls (entry 1 no catalyst; entry 6 no light: not detected). 'Conversion' has a non-standard definition (carbon in products + COx).
Flow WHSV results (selectivity 51% benzaldehyde / 31% acetophenone at 0.9 h-1; BA 18-74%) not covered.
